mutations.name: the original defect — no seal at tool-item creation, so post-tool text is appended to the first message item and done comes out [1,0]
the seal fires but does not re-arm the item — messageStarted stays latched, so no second item ever opens
the second item reuses the first item's id, so a client keying by item_id sees one item updated rather than two items
segmentText is never reset, so the post-tool item republishes the pre-tool text
output_item.done reverts to the whole-turn accumulator, so each item claims all the turn's text
output_text.done reverts to the whole-turn accumulator
the store commit takes only the last segment, so a chained next turn loses the pre-tool text
OVER-REACH CONTROL: the seal runs on every text delta rather than at a tool call, fragmenting every ordinary multi-delta answer
